snippet.title: FNAF Security Breach | Cut Content Restored | Night Mode Trailer
snippet.description:
Cut Content Restored is a mod for Security Breach that brings back the cut and unfinished content from early builds of the game. The main goal is to restore the original Pizzaplex layout, including all of the removed areas, old voicelines, and unused features, while keeping everything true to the vanilla style of the base game.

Soundtrack: Distorted Reality Perception by Leon Riskin

► Game Banana page: https://gamebanana.com/wips/90175
► Public Discord Server: https://discord.gg/bPEzy49VsA
